topic: Bernier's Account of Sati at Lahore
questionText:
Read the following excerpt carefully and answer the question that follows:

"Francois Bernier left a harrowing eyewitness account of the practice of Sati which he witnessed firsthand at Lahore: 'At Lahore I saw a most beautiful young widow, not more than twelve years of age, sacrificed. The poor little creature appeared more dead than alive when she approached the dreadful pit; the agony of her mind cannot be described; she trembled and wept bitterly; but three or four of the Brahmanas, assisted by an old woman who held her under the arm, forced the unhappy victim toward the pyre, seated her upon the wood, tied her hands and feet lest she should run away, and in that situation the innocent creature was burnt alive. questionText:
